svg.title: Mothlight Village measured building footprint
svg.desc: Proposed 120 by96 unit orthographic greybox. Eight resident plots, observatory, two reserved plots, accessible path spurs and42 fixed resource sockets. Coordinates are defined in plots.json. North is up.
svg.text: MEASURED BUILDING FOOTPRINT · PROPOSED AUTHORING PLAN
120 × 96 world units · 8 residents + observatory · 2 future plots · 42 resource sockets
Illustrative art is a mood reference.
Gates also require their story chapter.
Both Marsh gates share one unlock.
6-unit main roads · 4-unit door spurs · 3-unit future spurs · minimum 2-unit clear doors
01 = glass conservatory. 05 = Opal’s STONE workshop. 06 = restaurant + upstairs home.
Concept envelopes only. Validate terrain, colliders, wheelchair turning and mobile cameras in the game.
